conventions.cpu_irq_accounting_boundary: This guest kernel can charge interrupt time to the interrupted task; serial RPC interrupt activity may enter Guard or child cgroup counters
conventions.cpu_sample_timestamp: Guest monotonic time before sequential cgroup reads; per-counter read timing is not captured by this sampler
conventions.cpu_source: cgroup cpu.stat cumulative accounting, not isolated application instruction time

experiment: Baseline versus final event-filter + compact exception-location formatter: 3 baseline + 3 final at 20%, one final each at 10% and 5%; standard recovery RPC polling method

plot.cpu_window: five adjacent sample intervals, nominally 100 ms
